contracts.name: additive_visual_transformer_v1
contracts.base: frozen NF4 + LoRA r16 alpha32 dropout0.05
contracts.native_routing: original module, unchanged expert set, native k and native weights
contracts.small_normalized_sigmoid: native ordinary rows; equivalent log-sigmoid fallback only for a zero denominator
contracts.extra_routing: separate top-k over new blocks only; fixed mode all blocks
contracts.activation: valid visual positions and subsequent text; text-only request bypass
contracts.checkpoint_policy: one completed model-only object shared by best/last, no optimizer resume
